title.rendered: – Donations not tied to a Specific Project –

excerpt.rendered: We are especially grateful for donations not tied to a specific project! We allocate these funds to other projects as needed.These are usually projects involving students or inclusive classes that could not be fully funded through other sources.

On a plateau located about 5–6 km from Neustadt am Main and at an elevation of 400 meters, we are supporting the reforestation of an area of approximately 2 hectares that was largely cleared following a beetle infestation.
On two plots totaling 0.4 hectares, near the Leutenberger Hütte , the diseased spruce trees have been gradually removed in recent years due to drought and bark beetle infestation.

title.rendered: Langenselbold III / Hessen – Thermo Electron LED-Wald

excerpt.rendered: In the Kinzigauen (floodplains) near Langenselbold, we will be reforesting with Thermo Electron LEDs for the third time.
We plan to carry out a reforestation project with a team of employees / students on a hillside plot of approximately 0.2 ha along the Wagensteigbach in Buchenbach.

Above Falkensteig, on the ‘Unterer Kohlbachweg’, two small areas affected by natural disasters—each covering approximately 0.1 ha—have been left fallow for some time. We plan to introduce a suitable mix of deciduous trees to complement the existing conifer stand (a few young firs and Douglas firs).

On the Kohlenbach near Waldkirch-Kollnau, a small hillside area lies fallow due to drought damage. We want to supplement the existing natural regeneration of conifers with deciduous trees to achieve a more climate-resilient mix.
Above Elzach Yach, we manage a 0.25-hectare area that had to be cleared following a beetle infestation in 2025.
In the Sägendobel valley, above Haldenhof, we will support forest regeneration through group plantings in a small forested area of 0.3 ha.
In Kleines Wiesental, above the Riederbächle, we take care of an area of about 0.5 ha.
In the “Kreuzlinger Forst” ” landscape conservation area just outside Munich, a vast 4.7-hectare area of fallow land is to be reforested.

title.rendered: Waldkirch II / Baden-Württemberg – Porsche Zentrum Freiburg-Wald

excerpt.rendered: A small cleared area along the Kohlenbach near Waldkirch is awaiting reforestation. Spruce trees once stood here on 0.2 ha, but they were severely damaged by a bark beetle infestation.

Steinen is located in the Vorderes Wiesental valley of the Southern Black Forest. In the Hägelberg district, the dead spruce trees were removed in the fall of 2025; we will be replacing them with sustainable deciduous trees as part of several projects.

In St. Ulrich, a district of Bollschweil (south of Freiburg im Breisgau), above the Heinehof, there has been an area of fallow land for the past two years that we would like to reforest with your help.

title.rendered: Blumberg II / Baden-Württemberg – Rothaus Schwarzwald Classic-Wald

excerpt.rendered: Our land in Blumberg is being funded by Retro Promotion GmbH for the Rothaus Black Forest Classic over the years 2025 / 2025 / 2026.
East of Freiburg, near St. Märgen, on a steep slope above the Steinbach Valley, two damaged areas, each covering approximately 0.5 ha, are to be reforested.
Southeast of Freiburg, in the Mooswald forest in the municipality of Schallstadt, lies a section of forest that has been severely damaged by ash dieback.
We will be starting another project in Oberried. Not far from the Stollenbacher Hütte, at an elevation of over 1,100 meters above sea level, the old spruce stand had to be removed.

East of Freiburg, we are reforesting a private forest above the Weilersbach Valley. The area in question is a damaged site along the Weilersbach–Hinterwaldkopf hiking trail, covering approximately 1 ha.
At an elevation of approximately 1,250 meters, near the “Erlenbacher Hut” above Oberried, lies a fallow area that fell victim to drought and bark beetles some time ago.
Above Oberndorf am Neckar, right along the hiking trail to the Boller Felsen, we are planning to reforest a hillside.
Near the Nuremberg Golf Range, we are gradually transforming a former spruce monoculture covering approximately 3.6 ha into a healthy, sustainable mixed forest.
In Münstertal (south of Freiburg im Breisgau), directly above Stohrenstrasse , there is a former spruce monoculture that has become fallow land due to drought and bark beetle infestation.
Our support is needed in Thuringia as well. Near Löhma, on a plateau-like area of the Thuringian Slate Mountains, a 1.5-hectare plot of fallow land is waiting to be reforested.

In the landscape conservation area near Lenzkirch-Grünwald in the Upper Black Forest, at an elevation of approximately 950 meters above sea level, there are three sections of a former farm forest (used for lumber) covering a total area of approximately 0.24 ha.
IIn the Dietenbach Valley near Kirchzarten, we have a plot with a remnant stand of fir trees, the overgrown front section of which is to be reforested.
North of Irndorf, on the edge of the Swabian Alb, we manage 0.4 ha of a former pure spruce stand. Windthrow, bark beetles, and red rot have taken a toll on the stand.

In Hüfingen-Mundelfingen, near the Wutach Gorge, we plan to plant a 0.25-hectare fallow area with many different tree species. Both the spruce and the ash trees were diseased and had to be cleared in the spring of 2026.Diversity is the name of the game here as we plan to plant oak, beech, and hazel as truffle trees. Rounded out with serviceberry, service cherry, larch, and Douglas fir, it will be a colorful mix.
Our reforestation site is located near Frensdorf in Upper Franconia, south of Bamberg, on the eastern foothills of the Steigerwald.
Above the Wickenhof housing development in the Ibental valley, we manage a steep mountainside covering 0.55 hectares. The heavily damaged spruce monoculture will soon be cleared.
We are planning a forest restoration project in the Boehmenkirch area in the Goeppingen district, approximately 20 km from Eislingen-Fils / Geislingen an der Steige.

title.rendered: Blumberg III / Baden-Württemberg – KARL STORZ & KARL STORZ Stiftung-Wald

excerpt.rendered: There are currently a large number of newly damaged areas in the region around Blumberg. Another 0.8 ha of land that was formerly a spruce monoculture is to be reforested.

title.rendered: Blumberg I / Baden-Württemberg – Straub-Verpackung & Holzbau Bruno Kaiser-Wald

excerpt.rendered: Our very first myreforest woods! In Blumberg, in the Riedoeschingen district, we were able to purchase one hectare of fallow land. Here, we plan to create a natural, sustainable mixed forest.
On Wüstdobelweg above Waldkirch-Kollnau, there is an area of approximately 0.3 hectares that is scheduled to be planted in the spring of 2025.
